sourceTitle: Xocai Healthy Chocolate Sippin' Xo Cherie
sourceText:
Xocai Healthy Chocolate Sippin' Xo Cherie
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Sunday, September 9, 2012 - 11:43pm

Ingredients




2/3 cup milk ((Mug of Warm Milk)
1 tbsp dark chocolate (1-2 Tbsp Xocai Sipping Xocolate)
1 oz caramels (Caramel of Irish Cream)
1 drop whipped cream (Whipped Cream)
1 chunk dark chocolate (Xocai Nugget, shaved)
1 piece maraschino cherries (Maraschino Cherry, haved))

Preparation

1 Gently heat 2/3 of a mug of milk in double boiler or microwave so that is hot enough to melt the chocolate. Remove from heat and add Sipping Xocolate. Stir gently until Sipping Xocolate is melted and mixed well with the milk. Add liquor to fill mug half of the way up the final 1/3 of the mug. Spritz a healthy cone of real whipping cram on top. Sprinkle with chocolate curls form 1 Nugget. Top with halved maraschino cherry. Serves 1
